scores.tell: Barely any; the pi motifs are slightly large, otherwise it matches the real whistle card's finish and backdrop
The highlight on the planet is a touch strong; clean toy finish on a flat striped backdrop, like the towel card
The figure-8 layout is a little stiff and empty in the middle; the rope finish and palette look real
The hat body is a heavy, near-black indigo mass with weak form modeling; real heroes keep brighter local color
A wide scenic pier with deep perspective and busy caustic water; close to the real scene cards but more detailed
The visor has a lacquered hot spot and the lilac backdrop is pale and pastel; the helmet bubble is slightly puffy
A stiff, tall, narrow boot in flat side profile with realistic creased leather; less compact and lively than the real boots
Smeary, blurry, noisy grass and leathery panels give a realistic, AI-like render; the ball is cropped tight and nearly fills the card
Soft airbrushed painterly golf scene with deep rolling hills and busy grass blades; reads as a painting, not modeled game forms
Hazy, low-contrast pastel palette with a deep realistic city backdrop and a blobby, face-like airbrushed metal hero
